skills.name: Radical Zone
lines: Awakens Elemental Type Zones:
* Can be awaken if defined zone is Another Zone
* Doubles damage multiplicators for Zones:
** to +60% for Attack Zones and Thunder, Crystal, Shade (other elements) Type Zones
** to +100% for Fire, Water, Wind, Earth and Shade Type Zones
** Doubles "damage on weakness/resist" effects for Crystal/Shade Type Zone respectively
* Zone cannot be overwritten by other zones during the duration and duration cannot be extended by attempting to activate Another Zone or reactivate R. Zone
* Zone can still be removed/broken by skills that remove zones
* After duration ends, zone is removed
* Support Effects can be used at the same time as R. Zone
* Sonority effects will be strengthen in R. Zone
* Via active skills, can be activated only once per character
** When there is no appropriate zone or the zone is already awakened, using a skill that can "awaken" R. Zone will not consume awakening ability
** Non-active skill sources may activate it more than once per battle if explicitly stated
